flags.text: Kira's 50780 hero damage led all ten players by a fucking mile; Gadget's 31261 came second.
Five Gadget side-lane kills; four were followed within ninety seconds by Fangtooth or a structure.
Steel ran 55% kill participation, 16 wards and 30905 mitigated, with zero deaths before minute ten.
Four of five allied deaths outside any detected fight: Kira twice to Sparrow, Aurora twice to Countess.

focus.title: Convert fights, guard the side lanes
focus.action: Kira and Aurora: while Sparrow or Countess is unseen, move through side lanes and jungle only behind a ward or beside a teammate, and keep turning won fights into the nearest structure.

11.call: Khaimera killed Scarlett and Mourn, Sparrow took Kira, Steel killed Sparrow, and the first Fangtooth went allied once the fight ended. Fight first, then the pit: correct order.

16.7.call: Gadget killed Scarlett at the Fangtooth pit, Kira and Gadget cleaned up the duo lane, and Steel was the only allied death. The enemy duo outer and the second Fangtooth followed.

24.4.call: The first Prime pit kill went to Aurora on Countess and the fight went 4-2, with Steel finishing Sparrow and Lt. Belica. Orb Prime and the enemy duo inhibitor both fell in the window.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Mid lane run like a damn business: 10.1 CS per minute on a 5.4 norm, 1116 hero damage per minute on 776. Hold the pace whenever mid goes quiet.
The only death came to Lt. Belica on the allied half of mid, outside any detected fight. When Belica drops off the map, ward the mid flank before trading.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: 43119 objective damage, far beyond any other player, plus the most healing in the game at 13464. Keep starting the objective as soon as a fight is won.
Died to Scarlett in the allied jungle after the Aurora death, then Countess razed the allied offlane outer. With the offlaner down, call fight or tower first.
Hero damage ran 445 per minute against a 636 norm, 30% under. In a fight beside a pit, land Cull on an enemy hero before turning to the objective.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: The lone death came to Sparrow in the fight before the second Fangtooth, with Gadget killing Sparrow a second later. When Sparrow is the target, call the follow-up before engaging.
Allied wards outnumbered the enemy 40 to 31, yet Scarlett cleared 7. Before each Fangtooth, refresh a ward on the pit entrance using the third Leafsong ward slot.
6608e36b-a9ea-4d96-b465-eede20e00247: Both deaths to Sparrow outside any detected fight came on the duo lane. When Sparrow enters Heightened Senses stealth, hold Shadow Glide until Sparrow reappears.
Killed Sparrow and Mourn on the enemy duo lane, then razed the duo inner; a death to Countess followed. Once a tower falls with Countess alive, regroup first.
c4bfdcff-f030-48ab-a1df-3a1ebe86ef81: Two deaths to Countess outside any detected fight; after the second, Countess razed the allied offlane outer. With Countess missing from the offlane, farm under a ward or tower.
Hero damage ran 644 per minute on a 622 norm, with four deaths. At the next pit fight, open Cryoseism on Countess before the team commits.

matchup: Lt. Belica was the mid opponent: 2/5/2, with two of the five deaths to Gadget, including first blood.
Belica's Seismic Assault stuns, Neural Disruptor silences; Countess's Feast leaps in to suppress, a dive threat to a dashless mage.
build: Caustica ignores a share of magical armor, useful because Mourn's Contagion hands enemy heroes extra magical armor.
Soulbinder boosts long-range ability hits on heroes and permanently gains magical power from triggers on a cooldown.
Oblivion Crown, finished last, raises magical power by a quarter; earlier fights ran without Oblivion Crown.
eternal: Vesh repeats part of each ability hit on a hero as a burn; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
The Tenth Seal adds ultimate damage and ultimate ability haste from level ten, meaning more Tesla Dome casts.
Vesh is the most played Gadget mid Eternal, the sole option with enough games; no Vesh minor pair can rank yet.
augment: Auto-Lock Amp speeds up Seek and Destroy's homing toward an enemy hero.
Auto-Lock Amp is the most played Gadget mid augment and the sole option with enough games, so no edge is claimed.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a short window.
Epoch is the most played Gadget mid crest; Soulbearer has too few games to rank. Both evolve from Wizard Crest.
improvement: No change is proven: the field shows no edge for any alternative to the Eternal, augment or crest run here.
Kit read: Epoch's Stasis trades away Soulbearer's shield and lifesteal for a brief stasis when a dive lands.

matchup: Jungle opponent Scarlett finished 2/9/4 and cleared 7 wards; Khaimera killed Scarlett once, in the fight before the first Fangtooth.
Scarlett's Swan Song restrains, and Scarlett landed the first Khaimera death in the allied jungle.
Took 52943 damage, the most of all ten players, and died only twice.
build: Overlord's basic attacks cleave around the target, and Devourer grows maximum health on kills.
Sky Splitter deals current-health damage on basic attacks, a strong fit for burning down Fangtooth and Orb Prime.
Draconum stacks extra healing while damaging heroes or monsters and restores health on takedowns.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles at a low-health enemy hero; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a dash or leap such as Ambush.
Natural Resistance cleanses crowd control at low health, an answer to Countess's Feast suppress and Lt. Belica's stun.
Thraex is the most played Khaimera jungle Eternal and the sole option with enough games; Weald has too few to rank.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled inside the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion and Feral Ambush are a toss-up in the Khaimera jungle field; Jungle Invasion holds the better odds. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits, with weaker healing on each further hero hit.
Iceskorn Talons leads Khaimera jungle crest play; Judgement sits below the ranking floor. Both come off Champion Crest.
improvement: No field-proven swap: Thraex and Iceskorn Talons are only the most played picks, with no edge shown.
Against three magical damage dealers, Absolution adds magical armor and tenacity; with only two deaths, no item swap is proven.

matchup: Duo was Kira and Steel against Sparrow and Mourn; each duo lost a single death before minute ten.
Steel killed Sparrow four times, three on the duo lane, and Sparrow scored the only Steel death.
Mourn's Abduct pulls and Beguile mesmerizes; Sparrow's Heightened Senses grants stealth before the burst.
build: Tainted Charm cuts healing on nearby enemy heroes and slows nearby enemy heroes, trimming Mourn's Contagion and Countess's Blade Siphon.
Fire Blossom's physical armor also raises magical armor through the Hybrid Defence passive, softening the missing magic resist.
Raiment of Renewal, finished last, regenerates missing health out of combat; earlier fights ran without Raiment.
eternal: Krix grows maximum health by level; Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns and Regenerative Tissue regenerates away from hero damage.
Krix is the most played Steel support Eternal; Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the sole Krix pair with enough games.
augment: Heavy Metal adds bonus magical damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash, scaling with total physical and magical armor.
Heavy Metal carries nearly the whole Steel support augment field: most played, no rival with enough games to compare.
crest: Leafsong's active speeds nearby allies, makes allies immune to slows and lets allies pass through heroes; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Sanctification and Rift Walkers lead a toss-up in the Steel support field; Leafsong has too few games to rank.
improvement: Sanctification, the toss-up lead on the same Warden Crest path, trades Leafsong's speed burst for a team shield with tenacity.
No field edge over Leafsong is proven, so the crest swap stays optional; Krix and Heavy Metal match the most played picks.

matchup: Sparrow went 6/7/1 and scored three of the five Kira deaths.
Kira killed Mourn five times and Sparrow twice; five of those seven kills fell on the duo lane.
Countess's Feast suppresses, and Countess landed a Kira death on the enemy duo lane.
build: Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on basic attacks, blunting Mourn, Countess and Scarlett, the three top enemy healers.
Solaris empowers the next basic attack after an ability cast, healing for half the damage dealt.
Imperator, finished last, raises critical strike damage; earlier fights ran without Imperator.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage every third basic attack in a row; Serration adds missing-health damage; Breach shreds armor on Purge damage.
Weald is the most played Kira carry Eternal and the sole option with enough games; Vermis has too few to rank.
augment: Siphoning Purge heals Kira for a quarter of Purge's damage to heroes.
Bringer Of Mercy is the Kira carry field's most played augment; Siphoning Purge sits under the ranking floor.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize is a short dash plus a heavier next physical hit, multiplied on targets under a fifth of max health.
Pacifier tops Kira carry crest play with no rival holding enough games; Liberator stays unranked.
improvement: No field-proven change: Weald and Bringer Of Mercy are only the most played, so Vermis and Siphoning Purge stay a kit choice.
Kit read: Breach and Siphoning Purge both pay off only when Purge damages heroes.

matchup: Countess was the offlane opponent: 3/4/1 with 23884 hero damage, scoring two of four Aurora deaths.
Aurora and Countess each killed the other twice; the later Aurora kill on Countess came on the enemy offlane.
Countess's Feast suppresses and Shadow Slip slows; Shadow Slip's re-trigger swaps Countess back to the Shadow for an exit.
build: Magnify shreds magical armor on ability hits; Flux Matrix makes nearby enemy heroes take more magical damage with less tenacity.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, the answer to Countess's Blade Siphon and Feast healing.
Flux Matrix, finished last, was the only magical armor item; earlier fights ran without Flux Matrix.
eternal: Lich gives magical lifesteal growing at set levels, paired with Mind Rot's current-health bonus on the Vesh burn.
No Aurora offlane field data exists on the current patch, so Vesh is a kit read, not a ranked pick.
augment: Glacial Thorns makes Glacial Charge spawn Hoarfrost Crystals dealing damage and briefly rooting.
With no Aurora offlane augment counts yet, Glacial Thorns carries no field label either way.
crest: Tempest's active damages up to three nearby heroes every second and heals for part of the damage.
Tempest evolves from Warlock Crest; no Aurora offlane crest field exists yet.
improvement: No field-backed swap exists for Aurora offlane on the current patch; no change is proven.
Kit read: if Countess keeps winning trades, Flux Matrix before Tainted Scepter brings magical armor sooner and delays the anti-heal.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~1.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Mourn Abduct (pull), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down
